sys.meta.aviandex.theme: Premium printed naturalist field-guide collectible card: dark forest-green thick rounded frame with a subtle inner bevel, warm cream paper stock with fine fibre texture, flat print design, calm and authoritative like a real museum card
sys.meta.aviandex.dims: AvianDex bird encyclopedia card, portrait 3:4: (1) dark green header band across the top — large Traditional Chinese name on the left, italic scientific name beneath it, a white pill with the English name on the right, and a round IUCN badge at the far right; (2) one large rounded-corner portrait window occupying more than half of the card height, holding a single photorealistic bird, complete body, head clear, natural pose; (3) on the left edge of the portrait, a small vertical stack of 2–3 dark green habitat chips with white pictograms; (4) below the portrait, three game-style stat bars — gold fill on a cream track, a dark green rounded label on the left, the number on the right; (5) below that, a single row of four small white plaques, each with a slim dark green label and one sentence; (6) a slim dark green footer strip: NO. number on the left, Chinese name (scientific name) centred, version on the right
sys.meta.aviandex.finish: Matte letterpress paper, no foil, no gradient glow

sys.texts.aviandex: NO. number, Traditional Chinese name, scientific name (italic), English name, order · family, length, mass, IUCN badge, dex rating with stars, habitat chips, diet chips, four one-sentence plaques (look, diet, voice, fun fact), source line

外形 本種鳥類通體黑色，粗看起來頗似烏鴉，但是與烏鴉有着顯著的區別。
食性 八哥為雜食性，通過對八哥食物得研究發現植物性食物和動物性食物基本各佔50%的比例。
鳴聲 八哥生活在草原和山區的樹林中，善於鳴叫，也會模仿其他鳥的叫聲，經過訓練，還能模仿人類說話。
